# StatTile

A compact number tile for KPIs and "today at a glance", plus the context-distribution bar.

`CLR.StatTile` · Data display

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.StatTile label="…" value="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.StatTile" label="…" value="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (StatTileProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `value` * | `string` | Pre-formatted number, e.g. "12.3" or "1 h 48". Rendered in tabular numerals. |
| `unit` | `string` |  |
| `icon` | `ComponentType<LucideProps>` |  |
| `sub` | `string` | Secondary line, e.g. "1.4 h more than last week". |
| `trend` | `'up' \| 'down' \| 'flat'` | Direction only; never coloured red/green. |
| `plain` | `boolean` | No card chrome (inside another card). |
